MARINE ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JUNE 11, 2026
  130 CHERRY AVE.
  BIXBY PARK SOCIAL HALL, 2:30 PM

Jo Murray, Chair  Elizabeth Carlin, Commissioner
Bruce Mac Rae, Vice Chair  Gordana Kajer, Commissioner
Robert Blair, Commissioner  Elizabeth Lambe, Commissioner
  Theresa Marino, Commissioner

  SPECIAL MEETING

  Members of the public have the option to email public comments to
  tamalyn.sayre@longbeach.gov

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-55190  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Marine Advisory Commission
  meeting of Thursday, May 14, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-55284  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on Kayaks and Cleanups in the
  channel near Mother’s Beach.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-55191  Recommendation to endorse submission to approve a fee waiver for the Seal
  Beach Yacht Club (SLBYC), in an amount not to exceed $2,268.00, for use of 108
  parking spaces in Alamitos Bay Marina for The Charity Regatta Swap Meet on July
  11, 2026. (District 3)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-55192  Recommendation to endorse the submission to approve a fee waiver for the Little
  Ships Fleet Yacht Club, in an amount not to exceed $3,500, for use of dock space
  in Alamitos Bay Marina for racing and cruise celebrations for the period of June
  2026 through October 2026. (District 3)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-55194  Recommendation to receive and file the Manager's monthly oral updates.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Page 1 of 2
   MARINE ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JUNE 11, 2026
  130 CHERRY AVE.
  BIXBY PARK SOCIAL HALL, 2:30 PM

6.  26-55197  Recommendation to receive and file the Executive and Tidelands Capital Projects
  Committee status reports.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  26-55195  Recommendation to elect a chair and vice-chair of the Marine Advisory
  Commission, as required by Long Beach Municipal Code section 2.18.060.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

8.  26-55196  Recommendation to elect Commission members of the Marine Advisory
  Commission; for Executive, Finance, Maintenance/Operations, and Tidelands
  Capital Projects Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Marine Advisory Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Tamalyn Sayre, Bureau Secretary, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Marine Bureau at (562) 570-3215 by noon the
day prior to the meeting.
